## Hook patterns

- «When life gets wider, paying attention to the most important people gets harder»

## Voice characteristics
- Narrative anchors (personal anecdotes, specific scenarios)
- Contrasts and contradictions as tension-builders
- Punchy subheadings that preview insight
- Conversational tone, informal wisdom
- Direct address to reader's experience
- Brevity + psychological depth
- Skepticism toward conventional advice
- Focus on internal contradiction
